scope.summary: oracle_read_clob now refuses a primary key with no matching row as a typed OBJECT_NOT_FOUND naming owner.table and the key column/value, instead of returning isError:false with clob:null,row_count:0; a present row whose CLOB is NULL still succeeds with clob.value null.
out_of_scope: No change to crates/oraclemcp-db/src/**: the existing read_lob_sql is unchanged; the row-absence discrimination is made at the dispatch layer from the returned rowset.
crates/oraclemcp/src/cli.rs and crates/oraclemcp/src/main.rs are held by another agent and were not edited.
scripts/e2e/w4/** (cases and driver) and tests/golden/w4/** are another agent's lane and were not edited; the existing w4_read_clob_missing_pk_not_found case already expects OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.
The raw live pre/post JSON lives under /tmp/opencode/i1k2q/ and is not committed; this close claims scoped-test readiness, not a committed live artifact.

entry_points.name: oracle_read_clob MCP tool
entry_points.trace: Unit: cargo test -p oraclemcp --lib read_clob_ -> read_clob_missing_pk_is_object_not_found + read_clob_null_value_on_existing_row_succeeds + audit_wiring::read_clob_masked_and_certified all pass. Live free23 (localhost:1523/FREEPDB1, SYSTEM) with a fixture SYSTEM.I1K2Q_DOCS(ID NUMBER PRIMARY KEY, BODY CLOB) holding row ID=1 BODY=NULL and no ID=999: pre-change release binary returned pk=999 isError=false clob=null row_count=0 and pk=1 isError=false clob.value=null row_count=1; post-change debug binary returned pk=999 isError=true error_class=OBJECT_NOT_FOUND message='no row in SYSTEM.I1K2Q_DOCS with ID = "999"' suggested_tool=oracle_schema_inspect, and pk=1 still isError=false clob.value=null row_count=1. Planted negative: with the guard temporarily removed the unit test read_clob_missing_pk_is_object_not_found failed ('a missing primary key must not return an empty success'); the temporary weakening was reverted before the work commit.

limitations: Readiness basis is scoped-test: the live pre/post outputs were captured manually against free23 but are under /tmp/opencode/i1k2q/ and not committed as an exact-SHA artifact, so live_evidence is not claimed.

cargo fmt --all -- --check reports diffs only in crates/oraclemcp-db/src/connection.rs, which is unmodified in git status and outside this lane; the two changed files are fmt-clean.
No independent verifier re-ran the change; the swarm verifier must re-execute before closing.
